implemented.key: Before original [asset,level]/JSON.stringify key factory admit actual entry lifetime/control at 2048+12*asset.length, covering JSON worst-case six escaped UTF16 units per borrowed input unit plus fixed tuple/key/edge/control/native references. Capture actual tuple, actual JSON key and actual edge list/native pointers. At promotion reserve retained actual key/record/container slots at 592+2*key.length before actual Maps/Set inserts. implemented.edges: Preserve original four border calls and alpha short-circuit tests. Capture each actual ImageData and typed view reference immediately after its original native read. Drop actual edge list and tuple references after original consumers; native upload/input remains exact.
implemented.cache: Preserve original cached source LRU delete/set, 128 MiB source byte budget, 1024 unsupported-key oldest eviction, source/upload/raster-release order and cache return identity. Actual entry slot/key ownership follows native cache life. A successfully uploaded/inserted cache entry remains valid after original raster-release null, matching old behavior and retrying via cache. Source/owner disposal visits all entries despite first native null; original null survives secondary cleanup. Real device-owned native surface state is captured, so allocator-first already-destroyed handles are not submitted for duplicate release. Captured allocator refs drop after entry/header disposal.
implemented.cleanup: Native source/raster and every edge pixel owner are visited after upload/read/quota/null failures, preserving original error over secondary cleanup and allowing retry. Source cache then existing control native/backing cleanup visits all owners despite first error; control clears even after cache cleanup failure.
